data.name: Uttom
data.gender_notes: Uttom is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is the best, top, or excellent in every aspect. The name Uttom carries the meaning “Best, Top, Excellent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Uttom usually hope their child will grow to embody best, top, excellent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of excellence in spiritual life.
data.etymology: Uttom belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Best, Top, Excellent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uttom total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
